profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Let’s make the world a better place.
profile.summary:
My career is not just built on my hard work but also by those who have enabled and supported my growth.

Those people include my family, community, mentors, colleagues, those who have pushed to enable military spouses and veterans to have a chance and survive at civilian life, and even strangers who took the time out of their day to share their insights and experience.

I hope to give as much as they have invested in my future.

If you would like to help enable military spouses and veterans to build meaningful careers in tech, join me at Operation Code.

GitHub: https://github.com/ambergkim

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Improving UI/UX usability and brand implementation.

positions.title: Web Designer, Digital Marketer
positions.description:
Constructed business online real estate. Streamlined lead generation tools and marketing funnels, maximized productivity and automation, raised pageviews, improved user experience, created new streams of revenue and produced online courses. 60+ Businesses/Websites served and transformed.

CLIENT WORK EXAMPLES: http://sproutupdigital.com/portfolio/

positions.title: Tech Trainer & Pod Leader
positions.description:
- Led small groups.
- Helped entrepreneurs get their online business started.
- Built and published an online course.

positions.title: Tech Assistant
positions.description: I build the tech side of small businesses from websites to marketing funnels as part of the Wise Advice and Assist Team with military and veteran spouses.

positions.title: Conversion Optimization Intern
positions.description:
Volunteered for a great cause of encouraging the world to do more good works for each other. During my internship I worked with a remote team as part of the WordPress team and collaborated with project managers and designers to help build landing pages, website pages, marketing popups and opt-in forms, a/b tests, revise and optimize marketing campaigns built on multiple websites.

I also helped in the process of researching and troubleshooting website issues, installation of backup and security plugins, and other maintenance tasks.

positions.title: Virtual Assistant/Social Media Intern
positions.description: Social media content creation (research topics, blog writing, image creation, post commenting), social media management (social media plan creation, scheduling, task assignment, online collaboration through project management platform), logo creation, social media page setup and management, Wordpress website setup.

positions.title: Video Editor, Photographer, Videographer
positions.description: Documentary style photography, videography and video editing for events, company videos, and infomercials.

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.description: Production Assistant for shooting product documentary and company history.  Assisted with production equipment and lighting.

positions.title: Media Center Assistant
positions.description: Assistant for a media resource lending library, cataloguing and managing media, assisting in various office tasks including mailing, phone calls, emails, messages, data input.
